description: Synthetic project-step submissions for the validator benchmark (C-17). SUBMISSIONS are synthetic (team-authored) — that is fine for a benchmark. The ratings are NOT in this file: a human assigns humanLevel via the rating helper, and the validator assigns modelLevel via the snapshot script; both land in golden-set.json. Spread across build/language/debug and levels 0..max so the kappa is meaningful. `expectedHint` is a non-binding author note for the rater, not a rating.
